title: Saved Heat comparison after repeated CAD and solver execution
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace, click Workflows, choose the saved heat workflow and click Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Attach second run
manualSteps.instruction: Open the third recorded run link and inspect its CAD, analysis and held assessment results.

manualSteps.label: Reuse
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, select Heat-spreader candidate comparison and click Open saved interface. Inspect the full results; leave human reviews untouched.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the working interface and inspect the same third-run results and held assessment.

steps.label: Current installed workspace entry
steps.summary: The normal workspace opens on the same current installed package.
steps.purpose: Continue unreached authoring and preview checks after retained harness failures.
steps.actual: Workflows is visible on the current installed host.

steps.label: Open the retained working view before preview
steps.summary: The same saved interface renders the recorded engineering run before opening its preview.
steps.purpose: Reproduce the original working-to-preview journey with proper test-view cleanup.
steps.action: Open the exact retained saved interface link.
steps.expected: Working context and eighteen exact results.
steps.actual: The original run is visible with unchanged result identities.

steps.label: Existing built preview is read-only in a workspace tab
steps.summary: The saved job preview renders the same exact engineering outputs without compiler/model availability.
steps.purpose: Prove current installed preview hosting and authoritative read-only scope.
steps.action: Open the retained preview link for the exact saved revision and recorded run.
steps.expected: Read-only preview and exact same eighteen result identities.
steps.actual: Preview banner, backend read-only context and exact engineering result parity verified in 10078 ms (6976 ms before issuance). Earlier stopping reports remain retained; this separates issuance from frame loading.

steps.label: Reopen only the preview presentation
steps.summary: The explicit recovery control opens a fresh read-only presentation of the same recorded run and saved revision.
steps.purpose: Verify presentation recovery without generating or starting work.
steps.expected: New presentation identity, unchanged process/run/UI revision and exact eighteen results.
steps.actual: A new read-only presentation renders the same exact results; execution and authoring guards remain empty.
